title: Mission 2 — Shopping at Rīgas Centrāltirgus
summary: Settle in by buying groceries at the Central Market and a coffee at a nearby café.
summary_lv: Iekārtojies — iepērcies Centrāltirgū un nopērc kafiju tuvējā kafejnīcā.

scenes.title: Talk to the cashier
scenes.instruction: Greet Anna at the supermarket checkout and ask the price of milk.
scenes.instruction_lv: Sasveicinies ar Annu kasē un pajautā, cik maksā piens.

scenes.title: Pay by card
scenes.instruction: Tell Anna you will pay by card and ask for a bag.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasaki Annai, ka maksāsi ar karti, un palūdz maisiņu.

scenes.title: Order coffee at the café
scenes.instruction: Order a black coffee and a pastry from the waiter Jānis.
scenes.instruction_lv: Pasūti pie Jāņa melno kafiju un kūku.
